name: gb-power-markets
title: GB power markets, products and financial mechanisms
description: A database of Great Britain's electricity markets, balancing and flexibility services, government schemes and related mechanisms, with their operators, reference codes and sources. The CSV files are the master copy; this file describes them and is the data dictionary. Conventions: every CSV is UTF-8 with a byte order mark and CRLF line endings (R-001 Question 6; the BOM is to be reviewed before publication, R-019). A blank cell means not yet researched. The codes not_applicable and unknown are real values from the lookup tables, not missing values (R-001 Change 7). Coded columns are checked with foreign keys to the LK_* lookups, ORGANISATIONS or SOURCES rather than with lists written into this file, so a new code needs only a new lookup row. IDs are permanent (R-001 Change 1a). Some columns are still plain text while their lookups are drafted (R-020); their descriptions name the target. scripts/validate.py checks the data against this file, plus cross-table rules that a Table Schema cannot express. The data licence has not been chosen yet (R-019).

resources.name: key_data
resources.title: Mechanisms: key data
resources.description: One row per mechanism (market, product, scheme, charge or tax). This is the core table: market_info, technical, dispatch, participants and description hold one row per mechanism, with the same IDs in the same order. Becomes MECHANISM in Phase 4 (R-001 Change 13).

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Permanent mechanism ID: MEC- plus 4 digits (R-001 Change 1a). Never renumbered or reused; a new row takes the next free number.

fields.name: Market Name
fields.description: Name of the mechanism, as its operator uses it. Not unique: a few DSO tender lines share a name and are told apart by ID (R-001 Change 1; Phase 3 Change 12 resolves this).

fields.name: Mechanism Class
fields.description: What kind of mechanism this is. Code from LK_MECHANISM_CLASS. A new kind (for example a system charge or a tax) needs only a new lookup row.

fields.name: Category
fields.description: The system need or purpose the mechanism serves. Code from LK_CATEGORY.

fields.name: Market Operator
fields.description: The organisation that runs the mechanism: an ORG- ID from ORGANISATIONS. Blank means not yet researched, or no single operator (OTC trading). Other roles (policy owner, counterparty, platform) move to MECHANISM_ORG_ROLE (R-020).

fields.name: Acronym
fields.description: Common abbreviation, if there is one.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Lifecycle status. Code from LK_STATUS. A status_as_of date is planned (R-006).

fields.name: Commodity
fields.description: The physical quantity traded or procured. Code from LK_COMMODITY.

fields.name: Direction
fields.description: Direction of the action, relative to net export to the system. Code from LK_DIRECTION. not_applicable is a real code (researched; no physical direction), not a missing value.

fields.name: Contract Length Band
fields.description: Band for the length of the provider's contract. Code from LK_CONTRACT_LENGTH_BAND. Filled for some DSO sub-markets only; see R-022.

fields.name: Standard Variant
fields.description: DSO product variant: an Elexon FMR-PD standard variant, or a legacy or non-standard product. Code from LK_DSO_PRODUCT_VARIANT, whose product_code column gives the standard product. Filled only when Mechanism Class is dso_flexibility (checked by scripts/validate.py).

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Free-text notes, including qualifiers kept when values were converted to codes (R-021).

resources.name: market_info
resources.title: Mechanisms: market design
resources.description: Market design attributes: structure, timing, product and settlement periods, platform, auction and pricing rules, payments, and order-type parameters. One row per mechanism. Sparse: Phase 3 (R-001 Change 9) drops the empty columns and moves order-type parameters to ORDER_TYPES.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Mechanism ID (MEC- plus 4 digits). Each mechanism file has the same IDs in the same order as key_data (checked by scripts/validate.py).

fields.name: Market Name
fields.description: Copy of key_data Market Name, kept for readability. It must match key_data for the same ID (checked by scripts/validate.py). Can be dropped in Phase 3 (R-001 Change 1).

fields.name: Market Structure
fields.description: Who trades with whom (for example one buyer and many sellers). Plain text for now; R-020 decides whether it gets a lookup or is dropped.

fields.name: Market Timing
fields.description: When the auction or gate closes, relative to the delivery day (for example D-1 @ 14:00). Plain text. Phase 3 splits it into gate_closure_day_offset, gate_closure_time and an IANA time zone (R-001 Change 9).

fields.name: Market Period [mins]
fields.description: Length of the traded product period, in minutes. Text for now because some cells hold two values (30 / 60). Target in Phase 3: integer, with the two values split into min/max columns or separate rows (R-001 Change 9).

fields.name: Period Coverage
fields.description: Hours of the day that the market covers (for example 00:00 to 24:00). Plain text. Phase 3 splits it into delivery_start_time and delivery_end_time (R-001 Change 9).

fields.name: Settlement Period [mins]
fields.description: Length of the settlement period, in minutes. Text for now because some cells hold two values (30 / 60). Target in Phase 3: integer, with the two values split into min/max columns or separate rows (R-001 Change 9).

fields.name: Market Platform
fields.description: System or venue on which the market runs. Plain text for now. Target: a code from LK_PLATFORM, plus a platform row in MECHANISM_ORG_ROLE (R-020).

fields.name: Auction Type
fields.description: Auction format. Plain text for now. Target: a code from LK_AUCTION_TYPE (R-020).

fields.name: Pricing Structure
fields.description: How the price paid to accepted participants is set (for example pay as clear). Plain text for now. Target: a code from LK_PRICING_RULE (R-020).

fields.name: Market Objective
fields.description: What the clearing algorithm optimises. Plain text for now; R-020 decides whether it gets a lookup or is dropped.

fields.name: Market Co-Optimisation
fields.description: Whether the market clears jointly with other markets. The linked markets are named in Notes until MECHANISM_RELATIONSHIP exists (R-001 Change 13). Code from LK_YESNO: yes, no, not_applicable (researched, does not apply) or unknown (researched, no authoritative source).

fields.name: Overholding
fields.description: Empty in every row; its meaning is not documented. R-001 Change 9 drops it in Phase 3 and re-adds it as ORDER_TYPES rows only when sourced. Typed as plain text until then.

fields.name: Availability Payment
fields.description: Whether providers are paid for being available. Code from LK_YESNO: yes, no, not_applicable (researched, does not apply) or unknown (researched, no authoritative source).

fields.name: Utilisation Payment
fields.description: Whether providers are paid for energy delivered when they are used. Code from LK_YESNO: yes, no, not_applicable (researched, does not apply) or unknown (researched, no authoritative source).

fields.name: Payment Unit
fields.description: Unit of the availability or utilisation price (for example GBP/MW/h). Plain text; no lookup yet.

fields.name: Parent-Child Orders
fields.description: Whether parent-child (linked) orders are allowed. Moves to ORDER_TYPES in Phase 3. Code from LK_YESNO: yes, no, not_applicable (researched, does not apply) or unknown (researched, no authoritative source).

fields.name: Max Parent-Child Generations
fields.description: Largest number of generations allowed in a parent-child order chain. Moves to ORDER_TYPES in Phase 3.

fields.name: Max Children per Parent
fields.description: Largest number of child orders allowed for one parent order. Moves to ORDER_TYPES in Phase 3.

fields.name: Max Parents per Child
fields.description: Largest number of parent orders allowed for one child order. Moves to ORDER_TYPES in Phase 3.

fields.name: Curve Orders
fields.description: Empty in every row; its meaning is not documented. R-001 Change 9 drops it in Phase 3 and re-adds it as ORDER_TYPES rows only when sourced. Typed as plain text until then.

fields.name: Block Orders
fields.description: Whether block orders are allowed. Moves to ORDER_TYPES in Phase 3. Code from LK_YESNO: yes, no, not_applicable (researched, does not apply) or unknown (researched, no authoritative source).

fields.name: Maximum Block Size
fields.description: Largest block order allowed, written with its unit (for example 500 MW). Text for now because the unit is in the value. Target: a number in a column named with its unit, e.g. max_block_size_mw (R-001 Change 7).

fields.name: Loop Blocks
fields.description: Empty in every row; its meaning is not documented. R-001 Change 9 drops it in Phase 3 and re-adds it as ORDER_TYPES rows only when sourced. Typed as plain text until then.

fields.name: Curtailable Blocks
fields.description: Empty in every row; its meaning is not documented. R-001 Change 9 drops it in Phase 3 and re-adds it as ORDER_TYPES rows only when sourced. Typed as plain text until then.

fields.name: Linked Blocks

fields.name: Exclusive Blocks
fields.description: Empty in every row; its meaning is not documented. R-001 Change 9 drops it in Phase 3 and re-adds it as ORDER_TYPES rows only when sourced. Typed as plain text until then.

fields.name: Exclusive Links
fields.description: Empty in every row; its meaning is not documented. R-001 Change 9 drops it in Phase 3 and re-adds it as ORDER_TYPES rows only when sourced. Typed as plain text until then.

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Free-text notes. Some cells hold a source URL, which moves to SOURCES and CITATIONS (R-001 Change 5).

resources.name: technical
resources.title: Mechanisms: technical requirements
resources.description: Technical requirements on providers: response times, ramping, delivery duration and capacity limits. One row per mechanism. Units are in the column names. Phase 3 renames the columns to snake_case with a unit suffix (R-001 Question 3) and adds the dispatch fields (Change 10).

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Mechanism ID (MEC- plus 4 digits). Each mechanism file has the same IDs in the same order as key_data (checked by scripts/validate.py).

fields.name: Market Name
fields.description: Copy of key_data Market Name, kept for readability. It must match key_data for the same ID (checked by scripts/validate.py). Can be dropped in Phase 3 (R-001 Change 1).

fields.name: Max. Initiation Time [s]
fields.description: Longest allowed delay, in seconds, before the response starts. Text for now because at least one cell holds N/A. Target in Phase 3: number, with N/A recoded under R-001 Change 7.

fields.name: Max Time to Full Delivery [s]
fields.description: Longest allowed time, in seconds, to reach full contracted output.

fields.name: Lag Upper Bound Tolerance [s]
fields.description: Largest allowed lag, in seconds, behind the expected response. Text for now because at least one cell holds N/A. Target in Phase 3: number, with N/A recoded under R-001 Change 7.

fields.name: Ramp Time Upper Bound [s]
fields.description: Longest allowed ramp time, in seconds. Text for now because at least one cell holds N/A. Target in Phase 3: number, with N/A recoded under R-001 Change 7.

fields.name: Ramp Rate Lower Bound [pu/s]
fields.description: Slowest allowed ramp rate, in per unit of contracted capacity per second (the unit is still to be confirmed against NESO service terms; R-001). Text for now because at least one cell holds N/A. Target in Phase 3: number, with N/A recoded under R-001 Change 7.

fields.name: Delivery Duration [min]
fields.description: How long delivery must be sustained, in minutes.

fields.name: Minimum Capacity [MW]
fields.description: Smallest capacity that may take part, in MW.

fields.name: Maximum Capacity [MW]
fields.description: Largest capacity that may take part, in MW. Text for now because at least one cell holds N/A. Target in Phase 3: number, with N/A recoded under R-001 Change 7.

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Free-text notes.

resources.name: dispatch
resources.title: Mechanisms: dispatch
resources.description: Who dispatches the service, how, and whether it is used before or after a fault. One row per mechanism. Phase 3 may merge it into technical (R-001 Change 10).

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Mechanism ID (MEC- plus 4 digits). Each mechanism file has the same IDs in the same order as key_data (checked by scripts/validate.py).

fields.name: Market Name
fields.description: Copy of key_data Market Name, kept for readability. It must match key_data for the same ID (checked by scripts/validate.py). Can be dropped in Phase 3 (R-001 Change 1).

fields.name: Dispatcher
fields.description: Who instructs the provider (for example NESO, or Self for self-dispatch). Plain text for now. Target: an ORG- ID or the code self (R-020; R-001 Change 10).

fields.name: Dispatch Type
fields.description: How the provider is dispatched (for example automatic, or by BOA/OBP). Plain text for now. Target: a dispatch_method code (R-001 Change 10).

fields.name: Pre-Fault
fields.description: Whether the service is used before a system fault happens. Code from LK_YESNO: yes, no, not_applicable (researched, does not apply) or unknown (researched, no authoritative source).

fields.name: Post-Fault
fields.description: Whether the service is used after a system fault happens. Code from LK_YESNO: yes, no, not_applicable (researched, does not apply) or unknown (researched, no authoritative source).

resources.name: participants
resources.title: Mechanisms: eligible participants
resources.description: Which kinds of participant may take part, and the aggregation level. One row per mechanism. Phase 3 turns it into a long-format ELIGIBILITY table (R-001 Change 10).

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Mechanism ID (MEC- plus 4 digits). Each mechanism file has the same IDs in the same order as key_data (checked by scripts/validate.py).

fields.name: Market Name

fields.name: BMUs
fields.description: Whether Balancing Mechanism Units may take part. Code from LK_YESNO: yes, no, not_applicable (researched, does not apply) or unknown (researched, no authoritative source).

fields.name: Non-BMUs
fields.description: Whether units outside the Balancing Mechanism may take part. Code from LK_YESNO: yes, no, not_applicable (researched, does not apply) or unknown (researched, no authoritative source).

fields.name: Generation
fields.description: Whether generators may take part. Code from LK_YESNO: yes, no, not_applicable (researched, does not apply) or unknown (researched, no authoritative source).

fields.name: Demand
fields.description: Whether demand sites may take part. Code from LK_YESNO: yes, no, not_applicable (researched, does not apply) or unknown (researched, no authoritative source).

fields.name: Storage
fields.description: Whether storage may take part. Code from LK_YESNO: yes, no, not_applicable (researched, does not apply) or unknown (researched, no authoritative source).

fields.name: Suppliers
fields.description: Whether electricity suppliers may take part. Code from LK_YESNO: yes, no, not_applicable (researched, does not apply) or unknown (researched, no authoritative source).

fields.name: Aggregation
fields.description: Level at which units may be aggregated (for example GSP or National). Plain text for now. Target: a code from LK_AGGREGATION_LEVEL (R-020).

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Free-text notes, including confidence qualifiers kept from R-021.

resources.name: organisations

resources.description: Organisations that operate, regulate, settle or otherwise take part in mechanisms. Former names have their own rows, linked by predecessor_org_id and bounded by valid_from and valid_to (R-009).

fields.description: Permanent organisation ID: ORG- plus 4 digits (R-001 Change 1a).

fields.name: name
fields.description: Registered or official name.

fields.name: short_name

fields.name: org_type
fields.description: Kind of organisation. Code from LK_ORG_TYPE.

fields.name: parent_org_id
fields.description: Parent organisation (ORG- ID), for example the DNO group that a distribution licensee belongs to.

fields.name: url

fields.name: valid_to

fields.name: predecessor_org_id
fields.description: The earlier name or body that this row replaces (ORG- ID).

fields.name: registry_id

fields.description: Free-text notes.

fields.description: Canonical URL. A path inside this repository is allowed only when source_type is internal (checked by scripts/validate.py).

fields.name: doc_type
fields.description: Kind of document, from the R-001 Change 5 list (webpage, service_terms, rulebook, contract_spec, consultation, decision, dataset, statute, other). No lookup table yet.
